svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: MetaScreener: multi-dataset, multi-approach directionality screening
368 functional profiling strategies per mode · 12 meta-analysis algorithms · two directional indices
Step 1 Datasets and candidate signatures
k omics matrices (transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics, metabolomics), recalibrated
samples annotated with activation / inhibition labels, or continuous state variables
signatures from MSigDB, Enrichr, HMDB, PathCards, literature or custom sets
Step 2 Multi-pipeline enrichment (23 methods)
21 unsupervised: GSVA, ssGSEA, z-score, PLAGE, PCA, AUCell, UCell, singscore,
median, consensus, MDT, MLM, UDT, ULM, VIPER, WMEAN, norm/corr_WMEAN, WSUM ...
2 supervised: FGSEA (-log10 p x log2FC ranking), ORA (top 1000 up/down)
Step 2 Statistical testing per dataset
DiffMetaScreener: 6 tests (limma, t, ANOVA, Wilcoxon, Kruskal-Wallis, permutation)
CorMetaScreener: 10 measures (Pearson, Kendall, Spearman, LM, Biweight, Distance,
Percentage, Blomqvist, Hoeffding, Gamma)
23 x 6 = 138 differential pipelines · 23 x 10 = 230 correlative pipelines
Step 2 Directionalisation
two-tailed p → one-sided directional p (two2one)
activation and inhibition evidence are carried separately from here on
Step 2 Meta-analysis within a dataset
12 algorithms: geometric mean, invt, invchisq, logitp, CCT, meanp, meanz,
sumlog, sumz, sump, votep, wilkinsonp
Step 2 Aggregation across datasets
geometric mean of the per-dataset directional p-values
368 functional profiling strategies collapse into one directional p per signature
Step 3 Directionality indices
ADI = mean over the 12 algorithms of -log10(p_activation) (always positive)
IDI = mean over the 12 algorithms of log10(p_inhibition) (always negative)
DI = ADI + IDI, the net directionality used for ranking
Steps 4-7 Evaluation and application
robustness: gene removal, added Gaussian noise, removal of enrichment approaches
independent validation in RNA-seq, microarray and single-cell datasets
empirical consistency with established hallmarks; signature-guided drug discovery
DiffMetaScreener: activation / inhibition labels · CorMetaScreener: continuous state variables
